source_title: GE GFE28GMKES owner support (Water Filter RPWFE)
filter_location_text: GE RPWFE filters on French-door bottom-freezer models are typically in the upper left fresh-food compartment or behind the left door access panel.
replacement_steps_summary: GE support guidance for RPWFE: open the filter door, remove the old cartridge, install the new RPWFE cartridge per holder color (blue or grey), then reset the filter indicator when prompted.
cautions: GE recommends genuine RPWFE filters with RFID for leak detection; non-genuine filters may trigger leak-detected errors or disable the dispenser.
notes: Tier 1 GE bundle for GFE28GMKES — owner support documents Replace and Install the RPWFE Water Filter; GFE28G family in GE RPWFE compatibility matrix.
